_about: TCGdex set name -> the set name your PriceCharting collection uses (without the 'Pokemon ' prefix). A card added from a TCGdex set listed here lands in that existing set group instead of a new one. Letter case, accents and punctuation don't matter. Add a line when a new card shows up under a duplicate set; the right-hand name must be one scripts/build.py can resolve to a TCGdex set (its SET_MAP, or the same name as the TCGdex set).
